root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic axes: movement, especially walking, and growth or increase.
root_idea.development: The movement axis yields walking, proceeding, reciprocal movement, and causative bodily movement; the growth-and-increase axis is reflected in abundant offspring and livestock kept for breeding and gain.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I dictionary citation form.
Displayed as the Quran-attested verbal noun مَشْي.
Displayed as the distinct Quran-attested adjective مَشَّاءٌ.

senses.definition: To move or go from place to place; ordinarily, to walk or proceed on foot.
senses.usage_conditions: Applies to human and other-creature movement and may be rendered “walk” or “go” according to context. Quranic usage includes movement in a characteristic manner, walking humbly, and proceeding along the earth.

senses.definition: To go on, continue, or proceed in a course of action.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-attested construction in which the verb denotes continuing onward rather than merely taking steps.

senses.definition: Walking; movement from one place to another by volition.
senses.usage_conditions: As a verbal noun, it denotes the act of walking or moving. The Quranic occurrence is in a possessive construction referring contextually to a person’s pace or manner of walking.

senses.definition: One who goes about carrying tales or spreading malicious gossip; a tale-bearer.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic collocation بِٱلنَّمِيمِ, the form is an idiomatic characterization of carrying gossip rather than a reference merely to physical walking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass or become current, said of money and, figuratively, of a calumny.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical or figurative use, distinct from literal movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the belly to become active and discharge itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the bodily construction مَشَى بَطْنُهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To walk or go on foot with someone; to keep pace with him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal accompanying construction with a person as the companion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone’s bowels move or discharge, especially by means of medicine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the medicine or the bowels as the object of the causative action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a walk or to walk with slow, heavy, or effortful steps.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived form may be equivalent to مَشَى, but its reported general usage emphasizes slow or effortful walking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the intoxicating influence of wine to pervade or creep into someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative use, as in the influence of a drink entering or spreading through a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To walk toward or to one another.
To use a medicine, or an infusion of a plant, as a laxative or purgative.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may refer either to taking medicine or to drinking a plant infusion to move the bowels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A medicine that moves or purges the bowels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the expression دَوَاءُ المَشِيِّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A strong or energetic walker; one who goes on foot with vigor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader Classical specialization is distinct from the Quranic tale-bearing use of the same adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel with numerous offspring; more broadly, camels, cattle, and sheep or goats kept for breeding and gain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The broader collective use denotes livestock maintained for reproduction and profit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A passage or way by a place; a walking-place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A possible application is a ship’s gangway, as reported in the lexical evidence.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Continuing in a course of action.
Walking with someone and keeping pace.
Using a plant infusion to move the bowels.
